name: Vietnamese Caramel Chicken
notes: Judged worthy of keeping by Levi after water polo practice in August 2014. Serve with Jasmine rice and Asian vegetables. I like extra sauce, so I double those ingredients.

items: 1½ pounds boneless skinless thigh meat, cut in 2-inch pieces
¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper

steps.title: Heat the oil
steps.body: Swirl **4 tsp canola oil** in a hot pan.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Add **1½ pounds boneless skinless thigh meat, cut in 2-inch pieces** and cook on one side for two minutes.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.body: Turn the meat over and add **1 Tbsp minced fresh ginger**, **3 garlic cloves, minced** and **1 large shallot, thinly sliced**.

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.body: Meanwhile, mix the sauce ingredients together: **¼ cup chicken stock**, **3 Tbsp dark brown sugar**, **1 Tbsp soy sauce** (or fish sauce), **1 Tbsp fresh lime juice**, **¼ tsp salt**, **¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper** and **¼ tsp crushed red pepper**. Add to the pan when the chicken is no longer pink.

steps.title: Reduce the sauce
steps.body: Simmer until the sauce is reduced to about half, then add **6 green onions, cut into 1-inch pieces**.
